example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটা খেলনা না পেয়ে ছোটমুখ করে বসে রইল।
example_sentences_in_english: He pouted after losing the game.
The child sat with a sulky face when he didn't get the toy.
note: This idiom describes a child's or person's expression of displeasure or disappointment through a contracted or pouting face, common in colloquial Bengali.
